EC1: - Has active CNV due to causes other than AMD in the study eye.
EC2: - Has retinal vascular disease [OR] or retinal degeneration other than AMD in the study eye.
EC3: - Has had intraocular surgery, [OR] cataract surgery [OR] or LASIK surgery on the study eye within 90 days prior to the study.
EC4: - Has had yttrium aluminum garnet (YAG) laser capsulotomy on the study eye within 30 days prior to the study.
EC5: - Has active inflammation, [OR] infection, [OR] or other severe ocular disease in either eye.
EC6: - Has aphakia in the study eye.
EC7: - Has uncontrolled glaucoma [OR] or a history of previous glaucoma filter surgery in either eye.
EC8: - Is a contact lens wearer [AND] and is [NOT] unable to [NOT] discontinue their use in both eyes for the duration of the study.
EC9: - Has a serious allergy [OR] to, or experienced a prior significant adverse reaction to fluorescein angiography (FA) [OR] or indocyanine green angiography (ICGA).
EC10: - Has participated in any other clinical trial [OR] and/or has taken any investigational drug [OR] or product within 90 days prior to the study.
EC11: Other protocol-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria could apply.
